content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(EDR-022 Service Account Spawns Interpreter Under Web Server CGO) AND (BIOC(EDR-022 Automated Discovery Binary Breadth Burst) OR BIOC(EDR-022 Privilege Escalation Read Fan Out From One Causality Chain) OR BIOC(EDR-022 High Rate Proc Cmdline Sweep Across Distinct Pids) OR BIOC(EDR-022 Filesystem Wide Suid Sgid Sweep By Service Account) OR BIOC(EDR-022 Staging Directory Script Executed By Service Account)) grouped by causality_id within 15m
rules.name: Shelf-Staged Enumeration Chain — One Causality Owner
